mentions.description: A personal blog written mainly for the author's own benefit that is steadily gaining readers. It is built with the Zola static site generator, custom HTML and CSS, and hosted on Cloudflare Pages, with Swift scripts written to speed up creating OG images.
mentions.audience: Written mainly for the author himself, though it is steadily gaining more readers.
